title: Nasruddin and the Ants
summary: Watching an ant colony carry grains of wheat into their mound, Nasruddin placed a lump of sugar in their path....
full_text:
Watching an ant colony carry grains of wheat into their mound, Nasruddin placed a lump of sugar in their path.

"Look," he told his apprentice, "these tiny creatures carry burdens three times their weight without complaining, while you complain about carrying two loaves of bread from the baker!"
moral: True industry works in silence without requiring drums and banners.
